subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Sacrifice of the Vampire
email_body:
Hi L.E.,

Your Deathless Night: Into the Dark series, with Sacrifice of the Vampire arriving in December 2025 and Vow of the Vampire as the finale, is a lovely run of fated mates, fierce witches and protective vampires, and a great moment to tell readers the story behind it.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few reels for Sacrifice of the Vampire is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, from concept and visuals to the finished files you can share with readers. It is entirely optional and sits alongside the feature, so you can take it or leave it as you see fit.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Sacrifice of the Vampire best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
